attack.note: Ability based. Autos only matter for Fury of the Swarm wave splash, Kinetic Fulmination stacks and Bladed Momentum. Her damage is Ravage, Primal Grasp pulses and Impaling Blades.

poke.note: No poke. She must jump in and commit with Ravage, then pull enemies into Impaling Blades.

damage.note: Primal Grasp pulls into Impaling Blades for a stun plus 150 damage, then a delayed Primal Grasp explosion (and a second one with Psionic Pulse). Assimilation turns her output into shields. The burst lands in about three seconds, so healing barely matters; what stops her is dying or being stunned first. Ravage's quest adds large flat damage over the game.

good_into.why: Ravage jumps in, Primal Grasp pulls and Impaling Blades stuns and bursts a backline target, and Psionic Shift gets her out.
Psionic Barrier plus Psionic Pulse stacks spell armor against spell damage dealers and Assimilation shields cover chip damage while she closes.
Pulled and stunned targets that cannot blink away eat the full Impaling Blades, delayed pulses and Summon Ultralisk.
Ravage and Fury of the Swarm clear waves quickly and she can rotate to gank a lone enemy with her combo.

bad_into.why: A stun or silence before Ravage lands removes her entire combo, and she has no escape without Psionic Shift.
Pulled targets are protected by a strong front line and healers, leaving her without a safe commit and no way out after she dives.
Her health is low and defences are conditional (Assimilation scales with damage dealt), so a fast dive kills her before shields grow.
If the enemy healer can keep the combo target alive through the stun, she is left deep in the backline with no kill.

wants_from_team: Followup damage and CC after her pull and stun
Allies who protect her once she commits
A tank who engages so she can follow
Wave support early so her Ravage quest completes
gives_team: Hard engage and a pull that isolates a target
Strong wave clear and early gank pressure
Spell armor to herself against casters
weaknesses: Very dependent on completing the first part of Ravage's quest
High mana cost for her combo
Weak while the quest is incomplete
evidence: Primal Grasp, Impaling Blades, Ravage quest
Psionic Barrier, Psionic Pulse, Psionic Shift, Boundless Fury talents
Icy Veins guide: incredibly vulnerable to crowd control, no escape without Psionic Shift
Measured: about 1899 hero damage, 4429 siege, 2499 damage taken per minute, 4.9 merc camps per game, win rate 0.552 over 248 games

lens_notes.damage_delivery: Ravage, Primal Grasp pulses and Impaling Blades. Autos only feed Fury of the Swarm and Bladed Momentum.
lens_notes.target_style: Impaling Blades and Primal Grasp hit areas, Maelstrom is a damage over time field. In practice it lands on one pulled priority target.
lens_notes.durability_source: Assimilation shields scale with damage dealt and are small early. Chrysalis and Psionic Shift are level 13 and 20 talents.
lens_notes.kill_pattern: Ravage into the backline, then pull and stun. Icy Veins stresses ganking from the first minutes, so flank_pick over a pure cc_chain.
lens_notes.escape: No escape without Psionic Shift, but Ravage can be cast on minions or structures to retreat and Chrysalis is a talent.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Impaling Blades stun (0.75 seconds), Primal Grasp pull and the Ultralisk stun heroic.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Psionic Barrier is spell armor and speed, not CC protection. Icy Veins: incredibly vulnerable to CC.
lens_notes.camp_play: Queen of Blades doubles Ravage damage to minions and mercenaries. Measured 4.9 camps per game is the highest of my ten heroes.
lens_notes.power_curve: The Ravage quest at 100 and 250 stacks decides her damage. Weak until the first part is done.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Maelstrom (damage over time and shields) is the standard heroic, Summon Ultralisk is a stun pick tool.
lens_notes.team_needs: Allies who stop her dying after she commits, a tank engage to follow, and wave support for the quest.
lens_notes.vulnerable_to: Any stun or silence before Ravage lands, bursts that kill her before shields grow, a strong frontline with a healer protecting the target.

lens_gaps: No value for pull or displacement on cc_profile or cc_delivery (Primal Grasp).
No lens for early quest dependence plus mana hunger (high mana for short cooldowns).
